title: Kohraam Hai Taboote
body:
kohraam hai taboote hassan uth'ta hai ghar se
kulsoom buka karti hai lipti hui dar se
ay waaye musibat
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kiye peet ke sar baal pareshan
khoon behta hai ashkon ki jagah deeda e tar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hashr hua charkh se girne lage taare
tukde jo gire tasht mein shabbar ke jigar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim jo jawan hote huwe karbobala tak
dekhenge hassan bete ko farwa ki nazar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaate huwe shabbir se shabbar ne kaha tha
ab kashti e deen tumko bachana hai bhawar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ek janaza hai ye dunya mein hassan ka
do baar uthaya jo gaya ek hi ghar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil seene mein majid na teher payega us dam
dekhe koi is gham ko shahe deen ki nazar se
ay waaye musibat
kohraam hai taboote hassan...
author: Majid Raza Abdi
